Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: Misread the OpenStreetMap data and incorrectly stated the ref as A5117 when the OSM page clearly showed ref=A41 on the Backford Cross roundabout. This led to an unsupported conclusion that A5117 was the referenced “major truck/trunk” road and premature task completion without proper corroboration.
